about: Colour rules of this prototype. The percentages are our team's own choice, not official limits. The keep-out radii (2.0 km around lander sites, 0.5 km around impact sites) follow NASA's 2011 recommendations for U.S. heritage sites (Section A1-3); applying them to every landed or impact site, the 3-sigma landing-precision rule, the 1.5 km gravel range and the class multipliers are our own estimates, not NASA numbers. Terrain shielding is an approximation.
